You’ll study all the major subject you need to master as a civil engineer, including structure, fluids, geo-techniques, materials, environmental impact, surveying, mathematics. You’ll build structure design and analysis as well as engineering mathematics and modeling techniques, by using specialist software, including Revit, AutoCAD, ANSYS and Midas. All our course are designed in industry focus. Choose civil engineering, build your career in NTU, and make huge impact to the world.
